entries.englishMeaning: Our Lord, do not hold us to account if we forget or make a mistake. Do not place upon us a burden like that placed upon those before us, or burden us with what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector; give us victory over the disbelieving people.

Notre Seigneur, ne nous impose pas ce que nous ne pouvons supporter. Efface nos fautes, pardonne-nous et fais-nous miséricorde. Tu es notre Protecteur ; accorde-nous la victoire sur les gens mécréants.

entries.englishMeaning: Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. Glory be to You; protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Whoever You admit to the Fire is disgraced, and wrongdoers have no helpers. We heard a caller calling to faith in our Lord, and we believed. Forgive our sins, erase our misdeeds, and let us die among the righteous. Grant us what You promised through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. You never break Your promise.

entries.frenchMeaning: Notre Seigneur, Tu n’as pas créé cela sans but. Gloire à Toi ; protège-nous du châtiment du Feu. Celui que Tu fais entrer dans le Feu est déshonoré, et les injustes n'ont pas de secoureur. Nous avons entendu un appel à la foi en notre Seigneur et nous avons cru. Pardonnez nos péchés, effacez nos méfaits et mourons parmi les justes. Accorde-nous ce que Tu as promis par l'intermédiaire de Tes messagers et ne nous déshonore pas le Jour de la Résurrection. Tu ne romps jamais ta promesse.

entries.frenchMeaning: Mon Seigneur, augmente mes connaissances.

entries.title: "لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين". [الأنبياء - 87].
entries.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ. .
entries.englishMeaning: None is worthy of worship except You. Glory be to You; I have been among the wrongdoers.

review.note: Quranic supplication. No fixed repetition count is specified by these verses.
review.noteFr: Supplication coranique. Aucun nombre de répétitions fixe n'est spécifié par ces versets.
review.noteAr: الدعاء القرآني . لم يتم تحديد عدد تكرار ثابت في هذه الآيات.

entries.frenchMeaning: Nul n’est digne d’adoration sauf Toi. Gloire à Toi ; J'ai été parmi les injustes.

entries.title: "رب لا تذرني فردا وأنت خير الوارثين". [الأنبياء - 89].
entries.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ. .
entries.englishMeaning: My Lord, do not leave me alone without offspring; You are the best of inheritors.

review.note: Quranic supplication. No fixed repetition count is specified by these verses.

review.noteAr: الدعاء القرآني . لم يتم تحديد عدد تكرار ثابت في هذه الآيات.

entries.frenchMeaning: Mon Seigneur, ne me laisse pas seul sans descendance ; Vous êtes le meilleur des héritiers.

entries.title: "رب أعوذ بك من همزات الشياطين وأعوذ بك رب أن يحضرون". [المؤمنون -…
entries.arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ. .
entries.englishMeaning: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of devils, and from their coming near me.

review.note: Quranic supplication. No fixed repetition count is specified by these verses.

entries.frenchMeaning: Mon Seigneur, je cherche refuge auprès de Toi contre les incitations des démons et contre leur approche.

entries.title: "ربنا آمنا فاغفر لنا وارحمنا وأنت خير الراحمين". [المؤمنون - 109].
entries.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ. .
entries.englishMeaning: Our Lord, we believe. Forgive us and have mercy on us; You are the best of those who show mercy.

review.noteAr: الدعاء القرآني . لم يتم تحديد عدد تكرار ثابت في هذه الآيات.

entries.frenchMeaning: Notre Seigneur, nous croyons. Pardonne-nous et aie pitié de nous ; Tu es le meilleur de ceux qui font preuve de miséricorde.

entries.title: "رب اغفر وارحم وأنت خير الراحمين". [المؤمنون - 118].
entries.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ. .
entries.englishMeaning: My Lord, forgive and have mercy; You are the best of those who show mercy.
